given: a SKU identifier that does not correspond to any known SKU
when: the warehouse team member requests that SKU's detail view
then: a not-found state is shown rather than an empty stock view or an error page

independence.rationale: AC4 covers a known SKU with no stock (empty state); AC5 covers the distinct case of an unknown SKU that does not exist at all, asserting a not-found state, not the empty-stock state. The two states must be told apart: not-found can be wrong (showing empty or a crash) while the known-SKU empty state renders correctly, so each fails independently.
